name: 360 ONE WAM Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest listed wealth and asset manager for HNI/UHNI clients (promoters 5.9%, FIIs ~56%); AUM Rs8.99 lakh cr (+31% y/y at Q2 FY27). Q2 FY27 revenue +4.8% y/y (total income +14%), PAT Rs300cr (screener, down from Rs315cr a year ago), interim dividend Rs7.5/share. UBS acquired 4.8% via a Rs2,112cr warrant exercise (2026-10-21/22). New CEO Aashish Agarwal (ex-Jefferies India) appointed 2026-09-23. Stock Rs1,137, P/E 39x, P/B 4.5x. Earnings depend on market levels, HNI flows, transactional revenue and a margin-lending/borrowing book (interest cost Rs361cr in Q2).

revenue_mix.segment: wealth management ARR (advisory and product fees)

exposures.mechanism: Transactional/capital-markets and brokerage-linked revenue ~25% of total (model est.): +20% traded value => +5% revenue at 1.3x operating leverage => PAT +6.5% x persistence 0.5, plus sentiment on a 39x-P/E stock => +5.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 AUM Rs8,99,481cr (+31%), revenue +4.8% y/y (TradingView), total income +14% (NDTV Profit), dividend Rs7.5/share; ARR growth accelerates despite profit slip (Investing.com 2026-10-15)
